faculty.name: Andy Alexander
faculty.summary: Studies spatial cognition and mnemonic processes in corticothalamic circuits using electrophysiology, neuroimaging, and behavioral experiments in mice and rats.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究空间认知和记忆过程在皮层-丘脑回路中的作用，使用电生理学、神经成像和行为实验方法在小鼠和大鼠中进行。

faculty.name: Michael Beyeler
faculty.summary: Studies how sight is restored in people with incurable blindness using behavioral experiments, immersive VR, and neurophysiological methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究如何通过行为实验、沉浸式虚拟现实和神经生理学方法恢复因不可治愈的失明而受损的视力。

faculty.name: Nancy Collins
faculty.summary: Studies social support and caregiving in couples, psychosocial predictors of health, and social perception in close relationships, using experimental, observational, and neuroendocrine methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究伴侣关系中的社会支持和照顾行为、心理社会预测因子对健康的影响以及亲密关系中的社会知觉，使用实验、观察和神经内分泌方法。

faculty.name: Daniel Conroy-Beam
faculty.summary: Studies how mate preferences influence mating decisions, using computational models and real couples.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究伴侣偏好如何影响择偶决策，使用计算模型和真实情侣进行研究。

faculty.name: Leda Cosmides
faculty.summary: Studies the evolution of human cognitive mechanisms, focusing on cooperation, social exchange, and reasoning about social exchange, using empirical methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类认知机制的进化，重点关注合作、社会交换以及社会交换中的推理，使用实证方法。

faculty.name: Miguel Eckstein
faculty.summary: Studies how the brain perceives and processes visual information, using psychophysics, eye tracking, EEG, fMRI, and computational modeling to understand everyday visual tasks like recognizing objects.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑如何感知和处理视觉信息，使用心理物理学、眼动追踪、脑电图（EEG）、功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）和计算建模来理解诸如识别物体和面孔等日常视觉任务。

faculty.name: Alan Fridlund
faculty.summary: Studies how facial expressions affect social interaction, including with nonhuman and imaginary others, using evolutionary and cultural perspectives.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究面部表情如何影响社会互动，包括与非人类和想象中的他者互动，采用进化和文化视角。

faculty.name: Shelly Gable
faculty.summary: Studies motivation in social interactions and close relationships, focusing on approach and avoidance motives.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社会互动和亲密关系中的动机，重点关注趋近和回避动机。

faculty.name: Tamsin German
faculty.summary: Studies how core knowledge systems develop and influence beliefs about supernatural concepts and social cognition in children and adults.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究核心知识系统的发展及其对儿童和成人关于超自然概念的信念和社会认知的影响。

faculty.name: Barry Giesbrecht
faculty.summary: Studies the functional consequences, mechanisms, and experience-based shaping of selective attention using vision as a model, combining cognitive psychology with fMRI, EEG, and neuropsychology.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究选择性注意的功能后果、机制及其经验性塑造，使用视觉作为模型，结合认知心理学与功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）、脑电图（EEG）和神经心理学方法。

faculty.name: Michael Goard
faculty.summary: Studies the neural circuitry underlying visual processing, decision-making, and navigation in mice using two-photon calcium imaging and optogenetics.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究小鼠视觉处理、决策和导航的皮层回路，使用双光子钙成像和光遗传学方法。

faculty.name: Scott Grafton
faculty.summary: Studies the cognitive architecture underlying action representation, focusing on sequence and skill acquisition, motor simulation, and sensorimotor transformation using fMRI, transcranial magnetic.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究动作表征的认知架构，重点在于序列和技能习得、运动模拟以及传感器运动转换，使用功能性磁共振成像、经颅磁刺激和高密度脑电图进行研究。

faculty.name: Emily Jacobs
faculty.summary: Studies how sex hormones influence brain structure and function in women and men using brain imaging and endocrine assessments.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究性激素如何影响女性和男性的大脑结构和功能，使用脑成像和内分泌评估方法。

faculty.name: Skirmantas Janusonis
faculty.summary: Studies the dynamics and self-organization of serotonergic axons in the brain, using transgenic models, advanced microscopy, and computational methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑中血清素轴突的动力学和自组织，使用转基因模型、先进显微镜技术和计算方法。

faculty.name: Ron Keiflin
faculty.summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of associative learning and decision-making, and their alterations in psychiatric disorders using behavioral tasks and neuroscience tools in rodents.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究条件反射学习和决策机制及其在精神疾病中的改变，使用小鼠的行为任务和神经科学工具。

faculty.name: Heejung Kim
faculty.summary: Studies how culture influences psychological processes, examining pro-environmental actions, social support, and interpersonal power.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究文化如何影响心理过程，包括亲环境行为、社会支持和人际权力。

faculty.name: Tod Kippin
faculty.summary: Studies the factors governing the action of cellular components of the nervous system that produce behavioral, endocrine, and cognitive processes, focusing on vulnerability and resilience to drug.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经系统的细胞成分如何产生行为、内分泌和认知过程，并关注药物成瘾的易感性和韧性。

faculty.name: Stan Klein
faculty.summary: Studies the nature of self, memory, and consciousness, focusing on the role of episodic memory in mental time travel.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究自我、记忆和意识的本质，重点关注情景记忆在心理时间旅行中的作用。

faculty.name: Regina Lapate
faculty.summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of emotion-cognition interactions, focusing on cognitive control, temporal memory, and adaptive emotion.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究情绪与认知交互的神经机制，重点关注认知控制、时间记忆和适应性情绪。

faculty.name: Laura Simone Lewis
faculty.summary: Studies the development of social cognition in humans and great apes using eye-tracking and behavioral methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类和大猿的社会认知发展，使用眼动追踪和行为方法。

faculty.name: Zoe Liberman
faculty.summary: Studies the origins and development of social cognition, including how children categorize and reason about social relationships from infancy to childhood.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社会认知的起源和发展，包括儿童如何从婴儿期到童年进行社会分类和推理社会关系。

faculty.name: Richard Mayer
faculty.summary: Studies how people learn from multimedia and computer-supported environments, focusing on multimedia learning, computer games for learning, and online tutoring systems.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究多媒体学习、计算机支持的学习环境以及教育游戏，关注如何通过多媒体和计算机技术帮助人们学习。

faculty.name: Michael Miller
faculty.summary: Studies the cognitive neuroscience of human memory and decision-making using fMRI, ERP, TMS, and signal detection analysis.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类记忆和决策的认知神经科学，使用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）、事件相关电位（ERP）、经颅磁刺激（TMS）和信号检测分析。

faculty.name: David Pietraszewski
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive mechanisms of social group representations and conflict, integrating social, cognitive, developmental, and evolutionary approaches.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社会群体表征和冲突的认知机制，结合社会、认知、发展和进化方法。

faculty.name: Kyle Ratner
faculty.summary: Studies how social contexts influence cognitive, affective, and biological processes, particularly intergroup reactions and their effects on social relations and well-being.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社会情境如何影响认知、情感和生物过程，特别是群体反应及其对社会关系和福祉的影响。

faculty.name: Nils Karl Reimer
faculty.summary: Studies how intergroup contact affects prejudices and social change, using advanced quantitative methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究不同群体接触如何影响偏见和社会变革，使用先进的定量方法。

faculty.name: James Roney
faculty.summary: Studies the evolved functions of hormones in regulating human psychology and behavior, focusing on how hormones influence mate choice and women's motivational priorities.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究激素在调节人类心理和行为中的进化功能，重点关注激素如何影响择偶选择和女性的动力优先级。

faculty.name: John M. Ruiz
faculty.summary: Studies psychosocial influences on health, focusing on individual-level factors and social behaviors related to cardiovascular and cancer diseases.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究心理社会因素对健康的影响，重点关注心血管和癌症疾病相关的个体水平因素和社会行为。

faculty.name: Jonathan Schooler
faculty.summary: Studies the nature of mental life, including mindfulness, mind-wandering, and creativity, using empirical, philosophical, and contemplative approaches.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究心智的本质，包括正念、心流和创造力，采用实证、哲学和冥想的方法。

faculty.name: David Sherman
faculty.summary: Studies how people respond to threats to the self, focusing on self-affirmation and environmental sustainability.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人们如何应对自我威胁，重点关注自我肯定和环境保护。

faculty.name: Ikuko Smith
faculty.summary: Studies the functional role of neural dendrites in synaptic computations using electrophysiology and two-photon imaging.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经树突在突触计算中的功能作用，使用电生理学和双光子成像技术。

faculty.name: Thomas Sprague
faculty.summary: Studies how actions influence neural representations of the world, using fMRI, EEG, and model-based analysis.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究行为目标如何影响大脑对世界的表征，使用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）、脑电图（EEG）和模型分析方法。

faculty.name: Karen Szumlinski
faculty.summary: Studies the biochemical mechanisms of drug abuse, focusing on glutamate signaling and its role in neuropsychiatric disorders.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究药物成瘾的生物化学机制，特别是谷氨酸信号传导及其在神经精神疾病中的作用。

faculty.name: Rene Weber
faculty.summary: Studies complex cognitive responses to media narratives, focusing on moral conflict, persuasion, and ADHD-related media multitasking.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究媒体叙事对复杂认知反应的影响，重点关注道德冲突、说服力以及与ADHD相关的媒体多任务处理。

faculty.name: Annie E. Wertz
faculty.summary: Studies how infants learn about plants using social and behavioral cues, focusing on avoidance behaviors and edibility learning.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究婴儿如何通过社会和行为线索学习植物，重点在于避免行为和可食用性学习。

faculty.name: Brandon Woo
faculty.summary: Studies how infants and children understand others' actions and minds, particularly in social contexts, using developmental experiments.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究婴儿和儿童如何理解他人的行为和心灵，特别是在社会情境中的认知发展实验。

faculty.name: Hongbo Yu
faculty.summary: Studies the neurocognitive mechanisms of social emotions like guilt and gratitude, their moral significance, and how they are shaped by culture.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社会情绪（如内疚和感激）的神经认知机制及其道德意义，以及这些情绪如何受到文化的影响。

faculty.name: ENGAGE Keynote Speakers
faculty.summary: Studies the impact of social relationships on health and well-being, particularly in Latino cultures, using social-personality psychology methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社会关系对健康和福祉的影响，特别是在拉丁裔文化中的应用，使用社会个性心理学方法。

faculty.name: Google Scholar
faculty.summary: Studies neural dynamics and network interactions in the brain.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑中的神经动力学和网络交互。

faculty.name: Computational Vision
faculty.summary: Studies visual system function and decision-making in biological organisms and artificial agents, using computational models and neurotechnology.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究生物有机体和人工智能代理的视觉感知和决策过程，使用计算模型和神经技术。

faculty.name: Francesco Bullo
faculty.summary: Studies the stability and functionality of biological and artificial neural networks, focusing on biologically-plausible learning schemes and oscillatory dynamics.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究生物和人工神经网络的稳定性和功能，重点关注生物可实现的学习方案和振荡动力学。

faculty.name: Jean Carlson
faculty.summary: Studies learning, memory, categorization, and decision processes in perception and cognition using network and complexity analysis.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究学习、记忆、分类和知觉与认知中的决策过程，使用网络和复杂性分析方法。

faculty.name: Miguel P. Eckstein
faculty.summary: Studies brain-computer interfaces and computational vision using signal processing and machine learning.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究脑-机接口和计算视觉，使用信号处理和机器学习方法。

faculty.name: Mary Hegarty
faculty.summary: Studies how people remember and learn information, using experiments and computational models.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究记忆和学习的认知神经科学，使用实验和计算模型方法。

faculty.name: Emily G. Jacobs
faculty.summary: Studies how sex hormones influence brain structure and function, using brain imaging and endocrine assessments.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究性激素如何影响大脑结构和功能，使用脑成像和内分泌评估方法。

faculty.name: Sung Soo Kim
faculty.summary: Studies how fruit flies navigate using neural circuits and multi-sensory information, combining electrophysiology and computational modeling.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究果蝇如何使用神经回路和多感官信息进行导航，结合电生理学和计算建模方法。

faculty.name: Matthieu Louis
faculty.summary: Studies how odor tracking (chemotaxis) is computed in the larval fruit fly brain using computational, electrophysiological, and optogenetic methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究果蝇幼虫大脑中气味追踪（化感趋性）的计算机制，使用计算、电生理和光遗传学方法。

faculty.name: Upamanyu Madhow
faculty.summary: Studies brain-computer interfaces, network complexity analysis, and signal processing.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究脑-机接口、网络复杂性分析和信号处理。

faculty.name: B.S. Manjunath
faculty.summary: Studies brain-computer interfaces and computational vision using network and complexity analysis.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究脑-机接口和计算视觉，使用网络和复杂性分析方法。

faculty.name: Wendy Meiring
faculty.summary: Studies computational models of cognitive processes, using computational neuroscience methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究认知过程的计算模型，使用计算神经科学方法。

faculty.name: Mike Miller
faculty.summary: Studies the psychological and neural processes underlying human memory and decision-making using fMRI, ERP, TMS, and signal detection analysis.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类记忆和决策的心理和神经过程，使用功能性磁共振成像(fMRI)、事件相关电位(ERP)、经颅磁刺激(TMS)和信号检测分析等方法。

faculty.name: Nina Miolane
faculty.summary: Studies the geometry of neural networks and signal processing techniques to understand brain dynamics.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经网络的几何结构和信号处理技术以理解大脑动力学。

faculty.name: Jeff Moehlis
faculty.summary: Studies network and complexity analysis in computational neuroscience, using signal processing and machine learning.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究计算神经科学中的网络与复杂性分析，使用信号处理和机器学习方法。

faculty.name: Craig Montell
faculty.summary: Studies how environmental cues like temperature, light, taste, and smell influence behavior in flies, using molecular, cellular, and genetic approaches.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究环境线索（如温度、光线、味道和气味）如何影响果蝇的行为，采用分子、细胞和遗传学方法。

faculty.name: Kevin W. Plaxco
faculty.summary: Studies protein folding and biomolecular engineering, aiming to understand the folding process and apply it to nano-scale electronic sensors and adaptable materials.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究蛋白质折叠和生物分子工程，旨在理解折叠过程并应用于纳米级电子传感器和可适应材料。

faculty.name: Julie H. Simpson
faculty.summary: Studies the neural circuits and algorithms that control complex behaviors, using genetic model systems like fruit flies and optogenetic methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究控制复杂行为的神经回路和算法，使用遗传模型系统如果蝇和光遗传学方法。

faculty.name: Ambuj K. Singh
faculty.summary: Studies dynamical systems in neuroscience, focusing on computational models of brain function.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经科学中的动力系统，专注于大脑功能的计算模型。

faculty.name: Spencer LaVere Smith
faculty.summary: Develops and uses novel instrumentation to study neural circuitry and its role in adaptive behavior.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发和使用新型仪器研究神经回路及其在适应性行为中的作用。

faculty.name: William Smith
faculty.summary: Studies the development and function of the nervous system in amphibians and tunicates, focusing on neural tube closure and neural circuits.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究两栖动物和海鞘的神经系统发育和功能，重点关注神经管闭合和神经回路。

faculty.name: Misha Sra
faculty.summary: Studies brain-computer interfaces and computational cognitive neuroscience using signal processing and machine learning.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究脑-机接口和计算认知神经科学，使用信号处理和机器学习方法。

faculty.name: Luke Theogarajan
faculty.summary: Studies neural circuits and nanosystems, focusing on biomimetic designs.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经电路和纳米系统，侧重于仿生设计。
